title: The Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal Funding Extended!
summary: As you are aware, musculoskeletal diseases are widespread and disabling, yet there’s no centralized platform for musculoskeletal omics data and no curative treatments.
bodyHtml:
As you are aware, musculoskeletal diseases are widespread and disabling, yet there’s no centralized platform for musculoskeletal omics data and no curative treatments. We're building a knowledge base to fill this gap, The Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal (MSKKP; mskkp.org), which focuses on advancing discovery, uncovering disease mechanisms, and helping identify therapeutic targets. The MSKKP has been funded for an additional four years via the National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases (NIAMS). 

During this time, we aim to make this a more mature and established portal. If you have used the resource in the past or if you are a new user, we invite you to take this survey which will help shape the resource over the upcoming years. Please feel free to share the survey with colleagues as well. If you are interested in serving as an early adopter of the resource, please contact help@kp4cd.org.
